sources.title: Intel cuts more jobs as CEO Lip-Bu Tan continues efficiency push
sources.description: Intel has reportedly begun another round of layoffs, with employees saying the cuts hit its global IT team. The company has not said how many jobs were eliminated. The cuts appear to be part of CEO Lip-Bu Tan’s push to make Intel leaner by cutting costs and streamlining operations.

sources.title: Intel is laying off employees again
sources.description: After a series of layoffs over the last two years, Intel has laid off workers again, Business Insider has learned.

sources.title: Intel plans to 'streamline' by laying off another 20% of its employees
sources.description: The company is expected to officially announce the layoffs later this week, reports Bloomberg.

sources.title: Intel to lay off over 20% of its workers. What we know
sources.description: The job cuts come as Intel works to modify its business operations.
